notes: entry.a = model id; mid.header hi16 = direction count, low16 = action id; item = direction; blob = per-frame data.
magic family resolves to <model>/<variant>/{front,back}.apg; mid low16 matches the variant for 87% of entries (rest use 0).
Residual model misses are entries with no shipped art (removed/server-side models); act misses are single actions without files (e.g. npc action 101).
